title: SAP S/4HANA Procurement - Requisition and Procurement Processes
summary: Official SAP S/4HANA guidance for procurement and requisition processes. Provides details on requisition generation, approval flows, and integration points useful for automation and mapping to Ariba workflows.
content: See the SAP Help Portal topic for procurement and requisition flows in SAP S/4HANA. This document covers how requisitions are created, processed, and integrated with downstream procurement systems.

title: SAP Ariba Glossary
summary: SAP Ariba glossary of terms and definitions. Useful as a reference for Ariba-specific concepts such as buyers, suppliers, catalogs, and common UI terminology.
content: SAP Ariba glossary entries provide definitions and usage notes for Ariba concepts which help map user questions to the correct Ariba operational term.

title: SAP Supply Chain & Procurement T-Codes (Reference)
summary: Common SAP transaction codes (T-Codes) used across Procurement, Vendor Master, Warehouse and Logistics. Useful as a local quick-reference for mapping user 'shortcuts' to the canonical SAP transaction.
content:
ME51N – Create Purchase Requisition
ME52N – Change Purchase Requisition
ME53N – Display Purchase Requisition
ME21N – Create Purchase Order
ME22N – Change Purchase Order
ME23N – Display Purchase Order
ME41 – Create Request for Quotation (RFQ)
ME47 – Maintain Quotation
ME49 – Compare Quotations
ME11 – Create Info Record
ME01 – Maintain Source List
XK01 – Create Vendor
XK02 – Change Vendor
XK03 – Display Vendor
LT01 – Create Transfer Order
LT10 – Create TO for Transfer Requirement
LT21 – Confirm Transfer Order
LX01 – Inventory Count
MIGO – Goods Movement
MB51 – Material Document List
MB52 – Stock Overview by Storage Location
VL01N – Create Outbound Delivery
VL02N – Change Outbound Delivery
VL03N – Display Outbound Delivery
MD01 – Create MRP Run
MD04 – Display Stock/Requirement List
ME2N – PO List by PO Number
ME80FN – General Analysis of Purchasing Documents
SE16N – Table View
SUIM – User Authorization Info
ST22 – Dump Analysis
SM37 – Job Monitoring
